The next map milestone

Connecting every entry.

863 of 874 directory entries have a sourced regional connection. 11 await geographical evidence review. This tracks access points, including related names and umbrella labels, rather than counting distinct nations.

The current priority is to connect every entry before resuming deeper profile research. A regional link does not mean that all relevant places or historical periods have been researched.
